title: Hadamard powers of Gram matrices and Generalized Cauchy-Schwarz inequalities
summary: The following inequality for vectors $\mathbf{v}, \mathbf{w} \in \mathbb{R}^n$ was considered in [Linear and Multilinear Algebra 74:1779--1798 (2026)]: \[\|\mathbf{v}^p\|\|\mathbf{w}^p\| - \langle\mathbf{v}^p,\mathbf{w}^p\rangle \leq \|\mathbf{v}\|^p\|\mathbf{w}\|^p - \langle\mathbf{v},\mathbf{w}\rangle^p,\] where $\mathbf{v}^p$ is the vector that is obtained by raising each entry of $\mathbf{v}$ to the power $p$.
